name.description: Optional name locally unique to the parent {@link FlowGraph}. Useful for user-facing APIs such as visualization.

inTypes.description:
key - port name
value - information about type associated with this port. This is useful for {@link FlowGraph.Edge} validation.

outTypes.description:
key - port name
value - information about type associated with this port. This is useful for {@link FlowGraph.Edge} validation.

parents.description:
ids of parent vertices in {@Workflow#parent} {@link FlowGraph}. NOTE: there can be multiple in the case
that several vertices in the parent {@link FlowGraph} were merged as part of translation to a single vertex
in the new graph.

timeout.description:
Timeout for the execution of the vertex. After timeout time has passed the vertex execution fails if not
successfully completed or failed already.

title:
A specialized {@link Workflow.Vertex} that represents an aggregation of control-based {@link Workflow.Signal}.
It is primarily used to feed multiple "$success" signals to a single "$start" input.
NOTE: this is not to be confused with {@link Workflow.Make}, which merges data.
Every {@link Workflow.Join} has a number of input ports, specified upon construction, one each for each
{@link Workflow.Signal} to be joined. In general, the input to a join should be control-based {@link Workflow.Signal}.
Output ports that represent data should simply be connected to the data input of the target vertex.
Every {@link Workflow.Join} has a single output port: "$success".
See {@link Workflow} for more details on port "$success".
```
-------------------                         ---------------------                       ------------------
| Workflow.Action | $success --------> $in1 |                   |                       |                |
-------------------                         |                   |                       |                |
                                            |  Workflow.Join    | $success ----> $start | Workflow.Batch | ...
-------------------                         |                   |                       |                |
| Workflow.Action | $success --------> $in2 |                   |                       |                |
-------------------                         ---------------------                       ------------------
```
name: Workflow.Join
